# Changelog

<!-- Generated by cairn from each plan's changelog entry and record. Edits here are overwritten. -->

## 2026-10-27 · Trustworthy project memory

Project memory is now plan history plus a developer-friendly changelog, replacing the area docs and lasting decisions that went stale unchecked. Each plan gets a changelog.md written at ship; docs/cairn/OVERVIEW.md is the changelog, newest first, linking each record. Session start prints the 5 newest entries plus a pointer, and the pane has a Changelog tab. Removed: cairn recall, cairn area skip, cairn decide --lasting/--promote/--replaces, and /cairn:map; each refuses with "was removed; the changelog replaces it". Old docs/cairn/system and decisions folders are no longer read or written. Version 0.7.0.

[Record](plans/2026-10-27-trustworthy-project-memory/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-21 · Cleaner pane and records

The pane became easier to read and records easier to find. Before, cards changed height on every tool call, a follow-up count nobody could act on kept growing, and plan folders did not sort by date. The pane now has three tabs: Now, History (the full timeline) and Records (every plan, with the record opening in the pane). New plans live in `docs/cairn/plans/YYYY-MM-DD-<slug>/`, and commands find old and new names. A plan closes with at most five open follow-ups, merged at close and expiring after two declines or 60 days. `cairn close` now requires a Findings section in the record. Added the `cairn records` command.

[Record](plans/2026-10-21-cleaner-pane-and-records/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-21 · Pane status bar and polish

The pane said "all phases done" while review was still running, hid spend and limits, ignored clicks on agent cards, and could not scroll to the end of long documents. Every tab now has a pinned bottom bar with stage steps, git state, model, plan cost, context, tokens, and 5-hour and weekly usage. The new `cairn step` command records what check, review and ship are doing, such as "Review · fixing 3 findings", and the header, `cairn status` and the status line show it. Agent cards show live tokens and an estimated cost, and Read all opens a full-height viewer with Back and Approve. `pane.tsx` was split into `header`, `cards`, `approval`, `doc` and `bar`.

[Record](plans/2026-10-21-pane-status-bar-and-polish/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-21 · Roomier pane visuals

The pane was hard to scan, and two approval rough edges remained. Text sat flush against the left edge, tabs stacked with no gaps, and the body was drawn black. The docked pane now has a one-column margin and blank lines between sections, using Box props in `hooks/mod/pane.tsx` only. A stop revised twice now leaves one "not approved" note instead of two. Approving a stop, in the pane or with the approve command, now answers the open chat question for that stop early, through a registry of open questions in `hooks/mod/approve.ts`. The transparent background was a best guess and was removed in the next plan.

[Record](plans/2026-10-21-roomier-pane-visuals/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-21 · Sharper interview and review

The interview never asked what a build was for, review covered only risky tasks, and security appeared only at review. Discover is now goal-first: it opens with a guess and a confidence number, asks one question at a time, and ends with a read-back card that needs an explicit yes. Every task gets a five-axis review, and risky ones also go to the new read-only `security-reviewer`; the PRD gets a threat model, and check scans for secrets and audits dependencies. `cairn close` no longer waits for the merge, and status shows "Closed · PR open" until the branch is in main. New review and security checklists were added.

[Record](plans/2026-10-21-sharper-interview-and-review/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-21 · Standard branch names

Branches now use standard names. New plans use `feature/<slug>` or `fix/<slug>`, and tasks use `task/<slug>/<task>`, replacing `sdlc/` and `sdlc-task/` names that read as tool plumbing in a branch list or PR. Worktree folders are named after the branch. Lookup keys on the branch the plan recorded, so hand-made branches are never mistaken for plans, and old `sdlc/` plans finish under their old names. The pane's Approve card now appears only when an approval would pass (`ready` in `status --json`), shows what is being approved with Read all, and approving there answers a later chat question for the same stop. Clicking an agent card opens its conversation.

[Record](plans/2026-10-21-standard-branch-names/RECORD.md)

## 2026-10-20 · cairn v0.2

cairn 0.2 made approvals provably the user's and put plan state in a live pane. Before, the model relayed approvals itself, pausing needed an agent turn, and bugs had no light path. Approvals and overrides now need proof: the mod holds a random secret in memory and writes only its SHA-256, which the CLI accepts once, or you run `--human` in a terminal. The model cannot approve or write `state.json`. Added the `/cairn-pane` pane and status line, instant pause and Stop now, a CLI-scored drift verdict at each phase end (`direction-checker`, `/cairn:direction`), the repro-first `/cairn:fix` lane, and `--file` and `--note-file` for long text.

[Record](plans/2026-10-20-cairn-v0-2/RECORD.md)
